Write API integration tests for uploadOfflineCheckins and an end-to-end browser test with a simulated offline and online switch. Cover the ordered three-item upload, an interrupted upload followed by a second reconnect, and the banner disappearing.

- WHEN 3 offline check-ins are uploaded THE SYSTEM SHALL show each once with its original time
- WHEN the connection is cut mid-upload and restored THE SYSTEM SHALL have stored every check-in exactly once
- WHEN all are sent and the internet is back THE SYSTEM SHALL not show the offline banner

title: Show 'not found while offline' message with paper-note instruction on offline lookup miss
body_md:
In the front-desk check-in screen (cmp-web-frontdesk), when the tablet is offline and a phone lookup against the saved IndexedDB snapshot (cmp-web-offline) finds no match, show the message "not found while offline" and tell staff to note the person on paper until the internet is back. The screen has a dismiss action that closes the message and returns to the empty lookup. Dismissing must not call the check-in endpoint or queue an offline check-in for that number.

## Acceptance criteria
- WHEN the browser is offline and the entered phone number is not in the saved list, THE SYSTEM SHALL show "not found while offline" and an instruction to note the person on paper until the internet is back.
- WHEN staff dismiss the message, THE SYSTEM SHALL add no entry to the offline check-in queue and send no POST /checkins request for that number.

title: Add end-to-end test for offline not-found message and no check-in on dismiss
body_md:
Write an automated browser test for the front-desk check-in screen with the network switched off after the snapshot is loaded. Enter a phone number of a member who signed up after the last snapshot and check the message appears. Dismiss it and verify that no check-in is stored in the offline queue and that no check-in is stored in ctr-db after the connection returns.

## Acceptance criteria
- GIVEN the network is down and a member signed up 2 minutes ago, WHEN the phone number is entered, THEN the screen shows "not found while offline" and the paper instruction.
- GIVEN the message is shown, WHEN it is dismissed and the network returns, THEN no check-in exists for that member.

title: Record WhatsApp delivered and failed status on reminders from the inbound webhook
body_md:
In cmp-whatsapp-adapter, extend the POST /webhooks/whatsapp handler (receiveWhatsappWebhook) so delivery status events update the matching ent-whatsapp-message by provider message id. Propagate the result to the related ent-reminder in cmp-reminders: delivered is recorded as delivered, failed as failed. A failed result queues no SMS or other-channel message. Events stay idempotent on the provider event id and the signature check stays first.

## Acceptance criteria
- WHEN WhatsApp reports a reminder message as delivered THE SYSTEM SHALL record that reminder as "delivered".
- WHEN WhatsApp reports a reminder message as failed THE SYSTEM SHALL record that reminder as "failed" and create no SMS or other-channel message.
- WHEN the same status event arrives twice THE SYSTEM SHALL change nothing the second time.
